focus: strict reconciliation audit schema/type validation, malformed SQLite values, orphan and sequence rejection, concurrent read-only validation, and corrupted audit recovery refusal
safety_boundary: Backup validation checks local SQLite integrity, schema version, required columns and indexes, ledger decoding, audit schema types/constraints, audit sequence and timestamp consistency, and cross-record references; it does not prove authenticity or off-host durability.

The v57 tests exercise declared type mismatch, nullable required columns, BLOB values, fractional generation values, invalid decisions, orphan keys, invalid sequence values, concurrent read-only validation, and read-only rejection of corrupted audit state.
Local SQLite tests do not establish distributed exactly-once execution or disaster-recovery RPO/RTO.
Real-money payment processing remains NO-GO until the provider sandbox is independently verified.
